owner_report_2026_11_15.statement_summary: framing changes reverted after a reload for everyone; uploads by link should stream from the link without the 20 MB limit and failed with 'impossible de sauvegarder le fichier'; album page colours kept the Canvas colour with the Canvas off; recent titles on Home looked bad; Ketmix rated 4/10 against Apple Music, Spotify and others; the pink accent colour was not respected outside album pages, artist pages and the player.
causes_found: storage refused every Canvas file: the public bucket did not list video/mp4 among its allowed types (server log: POST /admin/override 502 'Impossible de sauvegarder le fichier' at 13:58 UTC); fixed by a migration

no album framing had ever reached the server (no row in ketvoice_media_overrides, no framing POST in the logs): the framing was only published after a second 'Publish' tap, and an expired owner session answered 401 without a retry; the framing is now published on the editor's confirm button, and a 401 renews the session and retries once
GET /overrides was cacheable for 120 s: a list fetched just after a save could hide it; now no-cache, and the app keeps what it saved over an older list for ten minutes
the whole app's accent was replaced by the playing cover's colour when 'Cover colours' was on; now only album pages, artist pages and the player use artwork colours
album pages were tinted by the most vivid colour of the cover (a small gold detail on a black-and-white cover); they now use its dominant colour

changes: blends up to 64 beats in every setting but discreet (32)
tempo ranges 5/8/12 % with the tempos meeting half-way

blends may start under the last 2 (balanced) or 4 (DJ) sung bars, the outgoing voice band (220 Hz–4.5 kHz, centre of the stereo image) lowered by 80 %, except for titles ending on a last note at full level
a mix journal in the settings, copyable, recording kind, reason, measured tempos and keys, analysis confidence, precise or plain fade, clock confirmation and singing positions

the voice step-back only lowers a frequency band of the centre: on a real mix other centred instruments in that band are lowered too

owner_section_changes: Framing is published when the framing screen is confirmed; a failed sending keeps the draft with its error and a retry button.
Owner requests refused with 401 renew the session and are sent once more.

Studio: a Canvas can be given as a link (direct MP4, API answer or Spotify title) for catalogue overrides, a selection of published titles, a published title and an album: the link is checked (its first bytes must be an MP4) and streamed from where it is, never downloaded, with no size limit.
Server: links accepted and never stored or deleted; video/mp4 allowed in storage; /overrides not cached.
known_limitations: Owner-section changes are deliberately not mentioned in the public release notes (owner preference).
A Canvas given as a link depends on the site that serves it: if it goes away or refuses streaming, nothing plays behind the title.
Ketmix needs the next title to be playable without a new resolution or one that succeeds in time; otherwise it says so and the title ends as before.
A manual skip is still a plain change of title: it is not mixed.
The mix journal is kept in memory only and is lost when the app is closed.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
